role: Reproducible user-facing visual baseline for Legacy comparison. Passing this baseline is not a Legacy parity decision; VQ-7 owns the parity gate.

capture.debugChrome: hidden for person/railway/transit/economy/performance diagnostic sections; normal user status chrome remains visible

goldenPolicy.technicalGolden: Renderer fixture and runtime structural contracts detect pipeline/layer regressions. They do not prove user-facing visual quality.
goldenPolicy.userFacingGolden: Five fixed runtime compositions provide a reproducible baseline for visual review and intentional VQ-1+ improvements.
goldenPolicy.updateRule: Update only after reviewing actual/diff artifacts and confirming the visual change is intentional. Never update only to make CI pass.
goldenPolicy.legacyParity: Legacy remains the minimum quality floor, but parity is reviewed and enforced by VQ-7 rather than inferred from these current-baseline pixels.

scenes.purpose: Read the broad settlement silhouette, terrain/water separation and overall city presence.
Read building mass, skyline and dense urban structure around the primary settlement.
Read the highest-degree delivered road intersection/interchange and road hierarchy.
Read railway/train presence using an authoritative active train position when available.
Read pedestrian/vehicle activity at street-biased range around the primary settlement.
